scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed && concurrently --names web,api,maths --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @eddy/web dev" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:maths"
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --package eddy-api alembic -c services/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:py
scripts.check:py: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy && uv run pytest
scripts.lint: eslint && pnpm -r lint && prettier --check . && node scripts/check-dashes.mjs && node scripts/lint-cliches.mjs
scripts.schemas:generate: pnpm --filter @eddy/schemas generate && uv run datamodel-codegen && uv run ruff format --quiet services/api/src/eddy_api/scenes/spec.py
scripts.scenes:golden: pnpm --filter @eddy/scenes golden && uv run --package eddy-maths-core python -m eddy_maths_core.scene_golden check evals/golden/scenes/specs.jsonl
